literal: On the renyin day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Ji, Consulting Colonel of General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was made Governor of Qing Province.
idiomatic: On the renyin day of the seventh month in autumn, Du Ji, Consulting Colonel of General Who Campaigns against Barbarians, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

literal: On the renzi day, Empress Yuan of the Yuan clan died.
idiomatic: On the renzi day, Empress Yuan of the Yuan clan died.

literal: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great flooding; on the jiwei day, envoys were sent to inspect the districts and provide relief.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered severe flooding; on the jiwei day, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.

literal: On the renzi day of the ninth month, the Primary Empress was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the renzi day of the ninth month, the Primary Empress was buried at Changning Mausoleum.

literal: On the wuwu day of the tenth month in winter, Liu Zhan, former Governor of Danyang, was guilty; he and his accomplices were executed.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the tenth month in winter, Liu Zhan, former Governor of Danyang, was found guilty; he and his accomplices were executed.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials were raised one rank of nobility.

literal: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was made Governor of Jiang Province; his title as Grand General remained as before.
idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, Minister over the Masses, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province; his title as Grand General was unchanged.

literal: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On the wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province with his former title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was made Governor of Yang Province; his vice directorship remained as before.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province while retaining his former title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Governor of Yang Province; his vice directorship was unchanged.

literal: On the bingxu day of the eleventh month, Liu Yirong of the Masters of Writing was made General Who Leads the Army; Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the eleventh month, Liu Yirong of the Masters of Writing was appointed General Who Leads the Army; Xu Zhanzhi, Supervisor of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.

literal: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "The field grain and seed previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu provinces that in recent years was remitted and should have been collected and forwarded—all are reduced by half.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "The field grain and seed previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain from Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu provinces that in recent years was remitted and should have been collected and forwarded—all are reduced by half.

literal: Where there was no harvest this year, [21] all is remitted.
idiomatic: Where there was no harvest this year, [21] all obligations are remitted.

literal: All overdue debts are to be generously assessed and reduced.
idiomatic: All overdue debts are to be generously assessed and reduced.

literal: Moreover, the appraisal taxes of the provinces and commanderies and the market levies wherever imposed are in many places burdensome and harsh.
idiomatic: Moreover, the appraisal taxes of the provinces and commanderies and the market levies imposed locally are in many places burdensome and harsh.

literal: The profits of mountains and marshes are still in some places forbidden and cut off;
idiomatic: The profits of mountains and marshes are still in some places forbidden and cut off;

literal: the categories of corvée summons extend even to the young and weak.
idiomatic: the categories of corvée summons extend even to the young and weak.

literal: Matters such as these injure governance and harm the people.
idiomatic: Matters such as these injure governance and harm the people.

literal: From now on all are to follow the laws and ordinances and strive to grant full favor and allowance.
idiomatic: From now on all are to follow the laws and ordinances and strive to grant full favor and allowance.

literal: If anything is inconvenient, report it separately according to the matter; do not hastily pursue momentary gain and thereby violate the intent of hidden compassion.
idiomatic: If anything is inconvenient, report it separately according to the matter; do not hastily pursue momentary gain and thereby violate the intent of hidden compassion.

literal: Those in charge are clearly to proclaim this below and make known my intent."
idiomatic: Those in charge are clearly to proclaim this below and make known my intent."

literal: On the guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, died.
idiomatic: On the guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, died.

literal: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: [22] On the wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was made Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Governor of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: [22] On the wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xiang Province, became Governor of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

literal: That year, the Prince of Wudu, the Prince of Henan, and Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: That year, the Prince of Wudu, the Prince of Henan, and Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: On the yimao day of the second month in spring of the eighteenth year, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was made Governor of Jiang Province.
idiomatic: On the yimao day of the second month in spring of the eighteenth year, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Zhang Commandery, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

literal: On the renwu day of the fifth month in summer, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, were both given the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.
idiomatic: On the renwu day of the fifth month in summer, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, were both granted the privilege of a separate office equal to the Three Dukes.

literal: On the guisi day, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.
idiomatic: On the guisi day, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.

literal: That month, the Han River overflowed its banks.
idiomatic: That month, the Han River overflowed its banks.

literal: On the wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were sent to tour the districts and provide relief and sustenance.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.

literal: On the xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.

literal: On the wuxu day of the seventh month in autumn, Zhao Bofu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was made General Who Leads the Army.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the seventh month in autumn, Zhao Bofu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

literal: On the xinhai day of the tenth month in winter, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping commanderies, was made Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the tenth month in winter, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping commanderies, was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

literal: On the yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.
idiomatic: On the yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.

literal: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.

literal: [24] On the jihai day, Meng Yan, Governor of Danyang, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: [24] On the jihai day, Meng Yan, Governor of Danyang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: The Di chieftain Yang Nandang again raided Han-chuan.
idiomatic: The Di chieftain Yang Nandang again raided Han-chuan.

literal: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, and Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, were dispatched to campaign against him.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, and Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, were dispatched to campaign against him.

literal: That month, [25] Cuan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Governor of Ning Province, suppressed and pacified him.
idiomatic: That month, [25] Cuan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Governor of Ning Province, defeated and pacified him.

literal: That year, Suote, Koguryo, Sumili, and Lin-yi all sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: That year, Suote, Koguryo, Sumili, and Lin-yi all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: On the yisi day of the first month in spring of the nineteenth year, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root; this is the far-reaching teaching of the sage and wise.
idiomatic: On the yisi day of the first month in spring of the nineteenth year, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root; this is the far-reaching teaching of the sage and wise.

literal: When the root is established, transformation is formed; instruction and learning are held precious.
idiomatic: When the root is established, transformation takes shape; instruction and learning are held precious.

literal: Therefore one is admonished with the three virtues and honored with the four arts, thereby able to receive all into the path of righteousness and bring them to measure and standard.
idiomatic: Therefore one is admonished with the three virtues and honored with the four arts, thereby able to receive all into the path of righteousness and bring them to measure and standard.

literal: In flourishing kingship and sagely ages, [26] all necessarily proceed by this.
idiomatic: In flourishing kingship and sagely ages, [26] all necessarily proceed by this.

literal: At the beginning of Yongchu the mandate was received and the statutes and regulations were broadly extended, intending to shape the myriad classes and unify diverse customs; there was an edict to the responsible offices to open the schools on a great scale, yet repeatedly encountering repeated adversity, construction was not completed in time.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongchu the mandate was received and the statutes and regulations were broadly extended, intending to shape the myriad classes and unify diverse customs; there was an edict to the responsible offices to open the schools on a great scale, yet repeatedly encountering repeated adversity, construction was not completed in time.

literal: Eternally gazing upon the former plan, I think to spread the great achievement.
idiomatic: Eternally gazing upon the former plan, I think to spread the great achievement.

literal: Now the regions are at peace and the barbarians and Chinese alike turn in admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of the state is truly the task of the age.
idiomatic: Now the regions are at peace and the barbarians and Chinese alike turn in admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of the state is truly the task of the age.

literal: Let the established regulations now be followed and the splendid enterprise proclaimed."
idiomatic: Let the established regulations now be followed and the splendid enterprise proclaimed."

literal: On the jiaxu day of the fourth month in summer, because a long illness had healed, for the first time the yue sacrifice was performed; [27] a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the fourth month in summer, because a long illness had healed, the yue sacrifice was performed for the first time; [27] a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On the gengyin day of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang; Chouchi was pacified.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang; Chouchi was pacified.

literal: In the intercalary month, the capital suffered rain and flooding;
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, the capital suffered rain and flooding;

literal: On the dingsi day, envoys were sent to tour the districts and provide relief.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day, envoys were dispatched to tour the districts and distribute relief.

literal: On the renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was made Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province.
idiomatic: On the renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was appointed Grand General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province.

literal: In the seventh month in autumn, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, was made Governor of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
idiomatic: In the seventh month in autumn, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, was appointed Governor of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, General of the Dragon Charger, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

literal: On the last day of the month, jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the last day of the month, jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On the jiashen day of the tenth month in winter, Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the tenth month in winter, Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: On the jihai day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was made Governor of Ning Province.
idiomatic: On the jihai day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was appointed Governor of Ning Province.

literal: On the bingshen day of the twelfth month, an edict said: "The sons of the state are beginning to gather and studies are just rising.
idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the twelfth month, an edict said: "The sons of the state are beginning to gather and studies are just rising.

literal: Since subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by events I think of those men, and my feelings are stirred with emotion.
idiomatic: Since subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by events I think of those men, and my feelings are stirred with emotion.

literal: The descendants of the Sage of Veneration may speedily deliberate succession.
idiomatic: The descendants of the Sage of Veneration may speedily deliberate succession.

literal: On the site of the former temple, a special structure is to be built; according to the old practice, an official for sacrifices is to be appointed, with offerings in the four seasons.
idiomatic: On the site of the former temple, a special structure is to be built; according to the old practice, an official for sacrifices is to be appointed, with offerings in the four seasons.

literal: Que-li in the past suffered bandit turmoil and the school buildings were ruined; orders are also sent down to Lu Commandery to repair the school quarters and recruit students.
idiomatic: Que-li in the past suffered bandit turmoil and the school buildings were ruined; orders are also sent down to Lu Commandery to repair the school quarters and recruit students.

literal: Former worthy men and sages, and even a single act of goodness, still perhaps guarded their hill mounds and forbade grazing and cutting; how much more does the Teacher whose virtue marks all the living and whose merit covers a hundred generations have his tomb mound overgrown and brambles uncut.
idiomatic: Former worthy men and sages, and even a single act of goodness, still perhaps guarded their hill mounds and forbade grazing and cutting; how much more does the Teacher whose virtue marks all the living and whose merit covers a hundred generations have his tomb mound overgrown and brambles uncut.

literal: Several households beside the tomb may be exempted from levies to attend to sweeping and sprinkling.
idiomatic: Several households beside the tomb may be exempted from levies to attend to sweeping and sprinkling.

literal: " The leading commoners of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and four other households, dwelling near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from their tax and corvée duties, supplied for sweeping and sprinkling, and six hundred pine and cypress trees were additionally planted.
idiomatic: The leading commoners of Lu Commandery, Kong Jing and four other households, dwelling near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from their tax and corvée duties, supplied for sweeping and sprinkling, and six hundred pine and cypress trees were additionally planted.

literal: That year, the state of Bapo sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: That year, Bapo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, at the east and west of Terrace City the Wanchun and Qianqiu gates were opened.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, at the east and west of Terrace City the Wanchun and Qianqiu gates were opened.

literal: On the jiaxu day of the second month, Yu Dengzhi, Governor of Jiang Province, was made Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the second month, Yu Dengzhi, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent.

literal: On the gengshen day, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was made Governor of Jiang Province.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

literal: Chouchi was overrun by the Suolu.
idiomatic: Chouchi was overrun by the Suolu.

literal: On the jiashen day, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Baixia.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the Emperor reviewed troops at Baixia.

literal: On the xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced in title to Grand General Who Campaigns West.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to Grand General Who Campaigns West.

literal: Shen Tan, Administrator of Baxi and Zitong commanderies, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
idiomatic: Shen Tan, Administrator of Baxi and Zitong commanderies, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

literal: On the jiawu day of the fourth month in summer, the sixth imperial son Dan was established as Prince of Guangling.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fourth month in summer, the sixth imperial son Dan was created Prince of Guangling.

literal: On the guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent, died.
idiomatic: On the guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, Director of the Army for the Heir Apparent, died.

literal: On the guichou day of the seventh month in autumn, Yang Wende was made General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.
idiomatic: On the guichou day of the seventh month in autumn, Yang Wende was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.

literal: On the xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Colonel of the Southern Man, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Colonel of the Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Governor of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were guilty; they were imprisoned and died.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Governor of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were found guilty; they were imprisoned and executed.

literal: On the guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Director of Punishments, was made Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Director of Punishments, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

literal: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month in winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrator of Shixing, was made Governor of Jiao Province.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month in winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrator of Shixing, was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

literal: On the renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take food as their heaven.
idiomatic: On the renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take food as their heaven.

literal: Therefore if one man ceases sowing, hunger necessarily reaches others.
idiomatic: Therefore if one man ceases sowing, hunger necessarily reaches others.

literal: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.
idiomatic: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.

literal: Recently wherever one looks there is destitution; households have no stores overnight.
idiomatic: Recently wherever one looks there is destitution; households have no stores overnight.

literal: When levies and corvée are for a time uneven, then the people harbor anxious distress;
idiomatic: When levies and corvée are for a time uneven, then the people harbor anxious distress;

literal: when the year is sometimes not abundant, sickness and want visit house after house.
idiomatic: when the year is sometimes not abundant, sickness and want visit house after house.

literal: Truly this is because governmental virtue has not won trust, thereby bringing these ills;
idiomatic: Truly this is because governmental virtue has not won trust, thereby bringing these ills;

literal: yet also farming and sericulture are not widely extended, and the land's profit is much left unused.
idiomatic: yet also farming and sericulture are not widely extended, and the land's profit is much left unused.

literal: Magistrates and prefects are slight in the methods of transforming and guiding; the common folk forget the meaning of diligent division of labor.
idiomatic: Magistrates and prefects are slight in the methods of transforming and guiding; the common folk forget the meaning of diligent division of labor.

literal: Speaking forever of broad relief, at dawn my thoughts are laden.
idiomatic: Speaking forever of broad relief, at dawn my thoughts are laden.

literal: Although regulations and orders are repeatedly issued, in the end none are warned and encouraged, yet sitting and looking for increase and growth—how can that be attained?
idiomatic: Although regulations and orders are repeatedly issued, in the end none are warned and encouraged, yet sitting and looking for increase and growth—how can that be attained?

literal: The responsible offices are to proclaim the old articles and strive to fulfill earnest instruction.
idiomatic: The responsible offices are to proclaim the old articles and strive to fulfill earnest instruction.

literal: Wandering idlers are all to be ordered to attach to occupations; diligence and sloth are to be examined and verified, and punishments and rewards applied; ability and conduct are to be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced.
idiomatic: Wandering idlers are all to be ordered to attach to occupations; diligence and sloth are to be examined and verified, and punishments and rewards applied; ability and conduct are to be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced.

literal: In antiquity the ruler personally plowed the imperial fields and respectfully supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, I think to follow the established canon.
idiomatic: In antiquity the ruler personally plowed the imperial fields and respectfully supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, I think to follow the established canon.

literal: Let a thousand mu be measured out and the primary day divined.
idiomatic: Let a thousand mu be measured out and the primary day divined.

literal: I shall personally lead the hundred officials and perform rites in the suburban fields, that sincerity and plainness may reach this people."
idiomatic: I shall personally lead the hundred officials and perform rites in the suburban fields, that sincerity and plainness may reach this people."

literal: That year, Hexi, Koguryo, Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys presenting local products.
idiomatic: That year, Hexi, Koguryo, Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: That year, in the various provinces and commanderies flood and drought injured the crops, and the people suffered great famine.
idiomatic: That year, in the various provinces and commanderies flood and drought injured the crops, and the people suffered great famine.

literal: Envoys were sent to open the granaries for relief, and grain and seed were granted and bestowed.
idiomatic: Envoys were sent to open the granaries for relief, and grain and seed were granted and distributed.

literal: On the jihai day of the first month in spring of the twenty-first year, Southern Xu, Southern Yu Province, and the districts of Yang Province west of the Zhe River [29] all prohibited wine.
idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month in spring of the twenty-first year, Southern Xu, Southern Yu Province, and the districts of Yang Province west of the Zhe River [29] all prohibited wine.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
